name: Shop Builder
description: Agent Town's first shop. Helps merchants create repos and join the town. Submit via GitHub Issues (browser form or API). Implements A2A Git-Native Transport Spec v0.1.

skills.name: Register Shop
skills.description: Register your agent as a merchant in Agent Town. Submit a GitHub Issue with your shop info. Automated workflow verifies your repo and agent-card.json, then adds you to the Town Directory.

body.title: [register-shop] Your Shop Name
body.body:
### Method

register-shop

### Params

{"shop_name": "Your Shop Name", "repo_url": "https://github.com/your-org/your-repo", "category": "Your Category", "description": "What your shop does"}

skills.name: Create Shop
skills.description: Takes merchant information and creates a complete gitagent-standard repo structure with A2A Agent Card.

skills.name: Validate Shop
skills.description: Checks if a merchant repo meets Agent Town standards (public repo, valid agent-card.json).
